Task.Title: JWT Bearer Authentication (Dual Auth)
Task.Description:
Cookie-based auth korunarak JWT Bearer auth eklendi. Mobil, masaustu ve 3. parti API erisimi icin.
Yeni Dosyalar: - Models/Entities/RefreshToken.cs (BaseEntity, UserId, TokenHash, JwtId, ExpiresAt, IsRevoked, DeviceInfo, IpAddress) - DTOs/Auth/JwtAuthDtos.cs (JwtLoginRequest, JwtLoginResponse, JwtUserDto, RefreshTokenRequest/Response, RevokeTokenRequest) - Services/AuthService.cs (IAuthService + AuthService: login, refresh, revoke, revoke-all, me) - Controllers/Api/AuthApiController.cs (5 endpoint)
API Endpoint'leri: - POST /api/auth/login (AllowAnonymous) - JWT token ile giris - POST /api/auth/refresh (AllowAnonymous) - Refresh token ile yeni token - POST /api/auth/revoke (Bearer) - Tek token iptal - POST /api/auth/revoke-all (Bearer) - Tum tokenlar iptal - GET /api/auth/me (Bearer) - Kullanici bilgileri
Guncellenen Dosyalar: - Data/ApplicationDbContext.cs (RefreshTokens DbSet + config) - Repositories/IRepository.cs + UnitOfWork.cs (RefreshTokens repository) - Services/JwtService.cs (GenerateTokenPairAsync, RefreshTokenPairAsync, Revoke islemleri, VendorCapability claims) - Program.cs (JWT Bearer scheme, dual auth default policy, IAuthService DI, API 401/403 JSON response) - Authorization/CapabilityPolicyProvider.cs (dual scheme: Cookie + Bearer) - DTOs/Auth/LoginDto.cs (UserDto.Id: Guid -> int) - appsettings.json (AccessTokenExpirationMinutes: 15, RefreshTokenExpirationDays: 30)
Onemli: - 38 mevcut API controller'a dokunulmadi (dual auth otomatik calisir) - Refresh token SHA256 hash olarak saklanir - JWT claims CustomUserClaimsPrincipalFactory ile ayni (IsSystemAdmin, VendorId, VendorCapability) - Migration: AddRefreshTokens (olusturuldu ve uyguland)
